program:
PARAMS = {
    "R":       (40e3, 10e3, 200e3),
    "It":      (24e-6, 8e-6, 40e-6),
    "I2":      (45e-6, 15e-6, 60e-6),
    "gmid_in": (15.0, 8.0, 20.0),
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "gmid_p":  (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "Lp":      (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "GBW":     (12e6, 4e6, 30e6),
    "fscale":  (1.0, 0.95, 1.05),
    "Q2":      (1.618, 1.4, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-12)
    R = float(p["R"]); It = float(p["It"])
    gmin, Lin = p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"]
    gmp, Lp = p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"]
    gmb, Lb = 12.0, 1.0

    def dB(x):
        return 20.0 * math.log10(max(float(x), 1e-30))

    # ---- current budget (power incl. reference) ----
    Ibud = 300e-6 / 1.8 * 0.94 - iref
    I2 = max(10e-6, min(float(p["I2"]), Ibud / 2 - It))

    # ---- device sizing (shared op-amp core) ----
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, iref, vds=mb0.vgs)          # ibias diode
    m1 = lut.size("n", gmin, Lin, It / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    vs = max(0.9 - m1.vgs, 0.1)
    m1 = lut.size("n", gmin, Lin, It / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=vs)   # diff pair devices
    vs = max(0.9 - m1.vgs, 0.1)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, It, vds=vs)                  # tail (mirror of mb)
    m3 = lut.size("p", gmp, Lp, It / 2, vds=0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("p", gmp, Lp, It / 2, vds=m3.vgs)          # PMOS mirror load
    m6 = lut.size("p", gmp, Lp, I2, vds=0.9)                 # 2nd stage CS
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, I2, vds=0.9)                 # 2nd stage sink

    gm1, gm2 = float(m1.gm), float(m6.gm)
    A0 = float(gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds) * gm2 / (m6.gds + m7.gds))

    def comp(cload):
        Cc = max(gm1 / (2 * PI * p["GBW"]), 1.0 * cload * gm1 / gm2, 0.3e-12)
        Rz = (1.0 + cload / Cc) / gm2        # zero cancels output pole
        return Cc, Rz, gm1 / Cc

    Cc1, Rz1, wt1 = comp(2e-12)
    Cc2, Rz2, wt2 = comp(cl + 1e-12)

    # ---- filter design: 5th-order Butterworth ----
    fct = 940e3 * p["fscale"]
    Q2 = float(p["Q2"])
    b1, b2, b3 = 1 + 1 / 0.618, 1 + 1 / 0.618, 1.0
    def g(x2):
        x0 = b1 - 3 * x2
        x1 = b2 / (2 * x2) - x0
        return x0 * x1 * x2 - b3
    lo, hi = 0.05, 0.5
    for _ in range(80):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if g(mid) > 0: lo = mid
        else: hi = mid
    x2 = 0.5 * (lo + hi); x0 = b1 - 3 * x2; x1 = b2 / (2 * x2) - x0

    NF = 1200
    freqs = [10 ** (3.0 + 5.3 * i / (NF - 1)) for i in range(NF)]

    def K(s, wt):
        A = A0 / (1 + s * A0 / wt)
        return A / (1 + A)

    def det3(a):
        return (a[0][0] * (a[1][1] * a[2][2] - a[1][2] * a[2][1])
                - a[0][1] * (a[1][0] * a[2][2] - a[1][2] * a[2][0])
                + a[0][2] * (a[1][0] * a[2][1] - a[1][1] * a[2][0]))

    G = 1.0 / R

    def resp(f, C0, C1, C2, C3, C4):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        k1 = K(s, wt1); k2 = K(s, wt2)
        M = [[2*G + s*C0, -G, 0],
             [-G, 2*G + s*C1, -k1*s*C1 - G],
             [0, -G, G + s*C2]]
        D = det3(M)
        M2 = [[M[0][0], M[0][1], G],
              [M[1][0], M[1][1], 0],
              [M[2][0], M[2][1], 0]]
        v2 = det3(M2) / D
        h1 = k1 * v2
        a11 = 2*G + s*C3; a12 = -k2*s*C3 - G
        a21 = -G; a22 = G + s*C4
        vc = (-a21 * G) / (a11 * a22 - a12 * a21)
        return h1 * k2 * vc

    def caps(w0):
        C0, C1, C2 = x0/(w0*R), x1/(w0*R), x2/(w0*R)
        C4 = 1 / (2 * Q2 * w0 * R)
        C3 = 1 / (w0**2 * R**2 * C4 * (1 + 1 / (wt2 * R * C4)))
        return C0, C1, C2, C3, C4

    def analyse(cs):
        h0 = abs(resp(10.0, *cs))
        rel = [abs(resp(f, *cs)) / h0 for f in freqs]
        fc = freqs[-1]
        lim = 1 / math.sqrt(2)
        for i in range(1, NF):
            if rel[i] < lim:
                fa, fb = freqs[i-1], freqs[i]
                ra, rb = dB(rel[i-1]) + 3.0103, dB(rel[i]) + 3.0103
                den = (ra - rb) if (ra - rb) != 0 else 1e-12
                fc = math.exp(math.log(fa) + (math.log(fb) - math.log(fa)) * ra / den)
                break
        pk = max(0.0, dB(max(rel)))
        att = -dB(abs(resp(10 * fc, *cs)) / h0)
        return fc, pk, att, dB(h0)

    w0 = 2 * PI * fct
    for _ in range(4):
        cs = caps(w0)
        fc, pk, att, g0 = analyse(cs)
        w0 *= fct / fc
    cs = caps(w0)
    fc, pk, att, g0 = analyse(cs)
    C0, C1, C2, C3, C4 = cs

    # ---- netlist ----
    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)

    def opamp(t, vp, vn, out, Cc, Rz):
        d1, d2, s, z = f"{t}d1", f"{t}d2", f"{t}s", f"{t}z"
        n.dev(f"M{t}1", d1, vn, s, "vss", m1)
        n.dev(f"M{t}2", d2, vp, s, "vss", m1)
        n.dev(f"M{t}3", d1, d1, "vdd", "vdd", m3)
        n.dev(f"M{t}4", d2, d1, "vdd", "vdd", m3)
        n.dev(f"M{t}5", s, "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
        n.dev(f"M{t}6", out, d2, "vdd", "vdd", m6)
        n.dev(f"M{t}7", out, "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
        n.R(f"Rz{t}", d2, z, Rz)
        n.C(f"Cc{t}", z, out, Cc)

    # stage 1: 3rd-order unity-gain Sallen-Key
    n.R("R0", "vin", "na", R); n.C("C0", "na", "vss", C0)
    n.R("R1", "na", "nb", R);  n.C("C1", "nb", "o1", C1)
    n.R("R2", "nb", "nc", R);  n.C("C2", "nc", "vss", C2)
    opamp("A", "nc", "o1", "o1", Cc1, Rz1)
    # stage 2: SK biquad, Q~1.62
    n.R("R3", "o1", "ne", R);  n.C("C3", "ne", "vout", C3)
    n.R("R4", "ne", "nf", R);  n.C("C4", "nf", "vss", C4)
    opamp("B", "nf", "vout", "vout", Cc2, Rz2)

    power = 1.8 * (iref + 2 * (It + I2))
    return n, {"fc": fc, "peaking_db": pk, "atten_db": min(att, 95.0),
               "gain_db": g0, "power": power}
